verdict.rationale: The evidence shows only glancing support for fleet provisioning. Docs describe generating and programming a custom attestation key pair onto 'maybe 100,000 devices' (solokeys-docs-5, docs-14), and the solo2 CLI can list connected devices, set admin options like the LED, and update firmware one key at a time (gh-2, gh-3, gh-4). Keys can also be wiped via fido2-token (docs-10). Nothing shows organization-scale pre-registration, bulk configuration, or tracking of issued keys, and a hands-on probe found the older solo-python CLI broken against current python-fido2 (probe-rt-1). Missing for 10: a pre-registration/enrollment workflow, bulk multi-device configuration tooling, inventory and lifecycle tracking of issued keys, an enterprise management console or API, and maintained admin tooling.
